Octal-rule interpretation validated by b-file agreement. Witness matrices are 8001x2000 int32 with zero -1 (closure) entries (16002000 candidates/game); 2000 random entries/game spot-checked: stored f satisfies q<=f<=N-p, G(f)!=G(f+p), and firstness over [q,f). Claimed maxima confirmed: .13337 max f=8002 at (7999,348) [also (8000,348)], G(8002)=131 vs G(8350)=128; .13137 max f=8001 at (8000,125) plus 18 tied rows, G(8001)=94 vs G(8126)=174. Cold lists recomputed from tables match exactly (11 and 18 entries). Extremal transcripts verified: .13337 n=10736 reachable set size 203 contains 0..186 and excludes 187, so G=187; prior max through 10000 is 163 at 9975; .13137 n=11796 reachable size 240 has min 1, so G=0. Guy-Smith window tested is [q,N-p] equality, and the stated consequence is honestly framed as a finite certificate, not an eventual-periodicity theorem.

Flammenkamp hub scopes systematic census to 0.???/4.??? plus 0.6111..., Grundy and 0.0n7 families with <=3-place nontrivial table (e.g. .16 period 149459/preperiod 105351); 5-digit .13337/.13137 lie outside with no recorded (n0,p). arXiv all-fields query '"octal game" 13337' returns no results. Hence G(10001..12000), the full (q<=8000,p<=2000) failing-witness box, new-interval colds, and record 187@10736 are neither recorded nor mechanically implied. Closest prior SCOPE attempts are distinct: 0.007 N=200 exclusion (different object, 60x smaller N, classical-scale box) and 0.057 positive-period closure (different code, opposite claim type).

value.rationale: Headline result judged on its own: 2000 new exact Grundy values per game past the pinned 10000 frontier, a 16M-candidate certified non-closure box with per-candidate failing witnesses, complete cold censuses, and a replay-certified record nimber 187@10736. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (Guy-Smith eventual-periodicity classification / Flammenkamp sparse-space program for open octals; dependent shift families anchored to these parents). Values were unknown and not mechanically implied. A future researcher classifying .13337/.13137 periodicity, testing sparse-space heuristics, or benchmarking solvers can reasonably need these precise facts; the exclusion box constrains any eventual period closing in this table to q>8000 or p>2000. This is a frontier-anchored finite exact-value/census result checkable by mex replay, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration.
